title: National Mental Health Support, Psychiatric Deficits & Tele-MANAS
target_user: National Mental Health Program Coordinators, Clinical Directors & Tele-MANAS State Leads
real_world_problem: Enormous mental health treatment gap (>75%) combined with severe societal stigma and a crippling shortage of qualified psychiatrists in rural and tier-2 districts.
actionable_decisions_supported: Allocating additional bilingual psychologists to high-volume Tele-MANAS cells, expanding the District Mental Health Programme (DMHP) to 100% of districts, and establishing psychiatric outpatient clinics in district civil hospitals.
data_provenance_and_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Tele-MANAS) & NIMHANS
analytical_capabilities_and_metrics: Total Tele-MANAS Calls Handled (1.46 Million Distress Calls)
Tele-Counseling Resolution (85.6% Distress Managed on Call)
Anxiety & Depression Share (53.4% of Inbound Consultations)
Emergency Clinical Referrals (4.4% In-Person Hospital Interventions)
methodological_limitations: Anonymized call detail records and clinical triage notes logged by trained clinical psychologists and psychiatric social workers at 51 Tele-MANAS cells nationwide.
